artists.source_line: 🔹 𝐀𝐥𝐟𝐫𝐞𝐝𝐨 & 𝐀𝐧𝐝𝐫𝐞𝐚 (Spain, 𝐄𝐒) – The best in the world.
🔹 𝐀𝐥𝐞𝐱 & 𝐎𝐫𝐧𝐞𝐥𝐥𝐚 (Sp/Fri, 𝐄𝐒/𝐕𝐄) – The power duo you’ve been asking for.
🔹 𝐀𝐝𝐢𝐥 & 𝐄𝐥𝐨 (France) – 2026 World Champion and United States
🔹 𝐌𝐫 𝐓𝐞𝐜𝐚𝐬 & 𝐓𝐚𝐬𝐡𝐚 (Angola/Fr, 𝐀🇴/𝐅𝐑) – The true ambassadors and the very essence of Angolan dance.
🔹 𝐃𝐲𝐰𝐞𝐧 (Toulouse, France) – The essence of Uban Kiz
🔹 𝐀𝐛𝐝𝐞𝐥 & 𝐇𝐨𝐮𝐝𝐚 (Casablanca, 𝐌𝐀) – Elegance and international technique.
🔹 𝐃𝐚𝐧𝐢𝐞𝐥 & 𝐈𝐫𝐚𝐭𝐢 (Pamplona, 𝐄𝐒) – They arrive directly from Navarre to convey to us all the energy and madness of the famous 𝐟𝐞̂𝐭𝐞𝐬 𝐝𝐞 𝐏𝐚𝐦𝐩𝐞𝐥𝐮𝐧𝐞! Get ready for a wild rueda! 💃🔥
🔹 𝐑𝐚𝐮𝐥 & 𝐃𝐚𝐧𝐢𝐞𝐥𝐚 (Colombia, 𝐂𝐎) – from Colombia literally with 𝐥𝐞 𝐟𝐞𝐮 𝐚𝐮𝐱 𝐩𝐢𝐞𝐝𝐬 for a dose of pure energy! 🇨🇴🔥
🔹 𝐌𝐚𝐦𝐛𝐨 𝐅𝐚𝐦𝐢𝐥𝐲 (Madrid, 𝐄𝐒) – An explosive show with 𝟏𝟎 𝐚𝐫𝐭𝐢𝐬𝐭𝐞𝐬 on stage!
🔹 𝐀𝐫𝐢𝐭𝐳 (San Sebastian, 𝐄𝐒) – Our talented neighbor from across the border!
🔹 𝐂𝐡𝐚𝐧𝐝𝐫𝐲𝐥 & 𝐌𝐚𝐫𝐢𝐨𝐧 (South West, 𝐅𝐑) – Our local champions and the pride of our region!
